directAnswer: You can open Task Manager by pressing Ctrl + Shift + Esc or right-clicking the taskbar and selecting 'Task Manager'.
summary: Task Manager is a system monitoring tool that provides information about the performance of your computer and running applications.

sections.heading: Methods to Open Task Manager
sections.body: There are several ways to access Task Manager, including keyboard shortcuts and context menu options.

sections.heading: Navigating Task Manager
sections.body: Once opened, you can view running applications, processes, performance metrics, and more.

steps.title: Using Keyboard Shortcut
steps.detail: Press Ctrl + Shift + Esc to directly open Task Manager.

steps.title: Using Taskbar Context Menu
steps.detail: Right-click on the taskbar and select 'Task Manager' from the context menu.

steps.title: Using Run Command
steps.detail: Press Windows + R to open the Run dialog, type 'taskmgr', and hit Enter.

steps.title: Using Windows Search
steps.detail: Click the Start menu, type 'Task Manager', and select it from the search results.

faqs.question: What if Task Manager won't open?
faqs.answer: If Task Manager doesn't open, try restarting your computer or checking for system updates.

faqs.question: Can I open Task Manager in Safe Mode?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can open Task Manager in Safe Mode using the same methods as in regular mode.

faqs.question: How do I end a task in Task Manager?
faqs.answer: Select the task from the list and click 'End Task' at the bottom right of the window.

caveats: Some methods may vary depending on your version of Windows.
